editorial.blurb: A no-frills dim sum institution in New Chinatown where authentic Cantonese cooking and affordable pricing make up for occasionally uneven service.
editorial.insiderTip: Be assertive when ordering and flag down staff early—they move quickly when busy—and always request extra dipping sauce and chopsticks before leaving, especially if taking food to-go.

topDishes.note: Consistently praised as tasty and a standout order
